answer.summary: This procedure loads customer data from a flat file into an in-memory indexed table for fast searching. It constructs a full name by concatenating first and last names and provides a lookup mechanism to find a customer's index by their ID.
inputs: CUSTFILE: Input file containing customer records (KDS_NR, KDS_VORN, KDS_NACHN, KDS_FICO)
outputs: KD_TAB: Global table containing indexed customer IDs (KD_NR), formatted names (KD_NAME), and credit scores (KD_FICO)
C@IX: The index position of the found customer (returned via KBU00019)

rules.text: If the customer table is full, log an error message 'KBU00018 KUNDENTABELLE VOLL' with error level 16.
Increment the customer counter when a record is added.
Store the customer ID from the file into the table.
Construct the full name by trimming leading/trailing spaces from the first name and last name, then joining them with a single space.
Store the credit score from the file into the table.
Search for the customer ID (C@NR) in the loaded table and return its index (C@IX).
